name: Molly-Core Cloud Womb
postAttachCommand: pkill -9 python 2>/dev/null; pkill -9 python3 2>/dev/null; unset PYTHONPATH 2>/dev/null; bash scripts/codespace-health.sh && npx tsx scripts/track-growth.ts --save && node scripts/save-session.mjs --status active --note 'Codespace reconnected' && (git add COPILOT_SESSION_STATE.json COPILOT_SESSION_STATE.md .github/copilot-instructions.md molly_data/system/growth_log.json && git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -m 'chore: session state on reconnect' --no-verify && git push origin HEAD &) 2>/dev/null; nohup bash scripts/keep-alive.sh > /dev/null 2>&1 &; nohup bash scripts/watchdog.sh > /dev/null 2>&1 &
